Sentence (English): Waiting for my third replacement.
Comments (English): [ Horrible, horrible experience! ] || ---------------- || Waiting for my third replacement. Hopefully this one will work. This is a premium appliance and I should not have any problems at all! The first two brand new dishwashers never made it through the very first cycle. I purchased this Kitchenaid 704 series over a Bosch 800 series because I liked the Kitchen aid features better. I bought it through a big box store and the delivery system was an absolute nightmare - so far I have been without a dishwasher for over a month. After the second dishwasher replacement I went back to the store and got a full refund. They never came back to get the dishwasher, even after my full refund. I tried contacting Whirlpool after the second replacement and I'm still waiting for a reply, a week later. I have now gone to a local appliance center to purchase this same model in hopes that my problems are an installation issue and not a problem with the unit itself. How can two brand new dishwashers have the exact same problem. The issue is that after about 10 minutes into the cycle the unit shuts off and starts beeping with an error code of F9 -E1. The manual tells me that this is a drainage issue. Either the hose is blocked or the garbage disposal knock out is still in place - neither is the case. The drain hose is brand new and the garbage disposal hook up was in use previously for the past 10 or so years without issue so, it can't be that either. If this third unit fails, I will definitely end up with the Bosch. Holding my breath…

Sentence (English): I bought this to replace my GE Profile dishwasher after the high water level sensor failed, we were wary of trusting it again.
Comments (English): [ comparing to GE Profile ] || ---------------- || I bought this to replace my GE Profile dishwasher after the high water level sensor failed, we were wary of trusting it again. Not sure about the filtration system yet, as there is a very small filter for "large food" particles, the GE model had a "large food" filter along with a mesh filter that was very easy to remove and clean periodically. Overall, I think the dishwasher will be fine, time will tell!

Sentence (English): I bought a dishwasher because my wrist hurts, and it's so good!
Comments (English): [ It's so comfortable, it's the best ] || ---------------- || I bought a dishwasher because my wrist hurts, and it's so good! I have to do a pre-wash, but it cuts the dishwashing time in half. Especially because I'm a bit picky about dishes. It took a long time to wash dishes. When I washed the dishes with hot water to clean them, my arms got hot, my face got hot, my back hurt, and it was so hard. When I use a dishwasher, I only have to do a pre-wash, and I just put detergent in it, and it washes everything else, so it's so good. I was worried that it wouldn't wash them cleanly because it's a machine, but it washes them cleanly. ^^ But the important thing is to arrange the dishes well so that the dishwasher can wash them well! If you just put them in carelessly, the dishwasher won't wash them properly! I think you should just be careful about this and use it. Also, I was worried that I would have to wash a lot of dishes every time I cook, so I was thinking about buying a large, built-in dishwasher. But then I had to measure the length again. I had to remove the drawers that were already there. I thought it would be a lot of work, so I bought a product that can be installed easily as a desk! But I'm satisfied. I only wash things like big pots myself, and put everything else like rice bowls, plates, and cups in the dishwasher! Anyway, it saves time, washes well, saves energy, and is satisfying in many ways. ^^ If my review was helpful, please click the helpful button. Thank you. ^^

Sentence (English): I got a coupon from Market Kurly.
Comments (English): I got a coupon from Market Kurly. I bought an LG genuine product for 620,000 won. The dishwasher itself is very convenient and good. When considering the purchase model, I chose the one with the pause function and the Up appliance function. However, I didn't use the pause function as much as I thought. (According to the service center, even models without the pause function can pause by slightly opening it by about 2 cm). In the case of the Up appliance function, I was told that I could download it before purchasing. The plastic-only washing function (low-temperature washing) was not there when I actually received it. Since there was an Up appliance idea suggestion in the app, I spent a lot of time and effort on it, but the response was slower than I expected. I only got rejection replies with inconsistent logic. They didn't review it sincerely, so don't waste time like me. Example) I wanted to wash and clean a plastic container, so I asked them to add a low-temperature washing course to the Up appliance. They said that it was not possible because the model did not have a hot air drying function, which has nothing to do with low-temperature washing. I got a weird answer. (I know that models that support hot air drying can have a plastic-specific course download.). So, since it's a model that doesn't support hot air drying, I asked again if they could just make a low-temperature wash that won't deform the plastic, and they replied that it's not a hot air drying model or something. (Since they don't plan on adding anything. They're probably telling me to buy an expensive model with a plastic-specific course. This is LG's reality, which is completely opposite to ESG.) From my own experience, the Up Home Appliances Idea Suggestion Department works based on the convenience of its employees, so it's virtually meaningless for customers to make suggestions. (Rather than expecting useful features, think of it as receiving a bell sound or something^^). Except for some air conditioner models, LGE.com products are expensive. If possible, buy dishwashers, robot vacuums, etc. from the online mall. Even if you buy them from other channels, an LG technician will install them for you.

Comments (English): I got a coupon from Market Kurly. I bought an LG genuine product for 620,000 won. The dishwasher itself is very convenient and good. When considering the purchase model, I chose the one with the pause function and the Up appliance function. However, I didn't use the pause function as much as I thought. (According to the service center, even models without the pause function can pause by slightly opening it by about 2 cm). In the case of the Up appliance function, I was told that I could download it before purchasing. The plastic-only washing function (low-temperature washing) was not there when I actually received it. Since there was an Up appliance idea suggestion in the app, I spent a lot of time and effort on it, but the response was slower than I expected. I only got rejection replies with inconsistent logic. They didn't review it sincerely, so don't waste time like me. Example) I wanted to wash and clean a plastic container, so I asked them to add a low-temperature washing course to the Up appliance. They said that it was not possible because the model did not have a hot air drying function, which has nothing to do with low-temperature washing. I got a weird answer. (I know that models that support hot air drying can have a plastic-specific course download.). So, since it's a model that doesn't support hot air drying, I asked again if they could just make a low-temperature wash that won't deform the plastic, and they replied that it's not a hot air drying model or something. (Since they don't plan on adding anything. They're probably telling me to buy an expensive model with a plastic-specific course. This is LG's reality, which is completely opposite to ESG.) (According to the service center, even models without the pause function can pause by slightly opening it by about 2 cm). (I know that models that support hot air drying can have a plastic-specific course download.). Sentence (English): They didn't review it sincerely, so don't waste time like me.
Comments (English): I got a coupon from Market Kurly. I bought an LG genuine product for 620,000 won. The dishwasher itself is very convenient and good. When considering the purchase model, I chose the one with the pause function and the Up appliance function. However, I didn't use the pause function as much as I thought. (According to the service center, even models without the pause function can pause by slightly opening it by about 2 cm). In the case of the Up appliance function, I was told that I could download it before purchasing. The plastic-only washing function (low-temperature washing) was not there when I actually received it. Since there was an Up appliance idea suggestion in the app, I spent a lot of time and effort on it, but the response was slower than I expected. I only got rejection replies with inconsistent logic. They didn't review it sincerely, so don't waste time like me. Example) I wanted to wash and clean a plastic container, so I asked them to add a low-temperature washing course to the Up appliance. They said that it was not possible because the model did not have a hot air drying function, which has nothing to do with low-temperature washing. I got a weird answer. (I know that models that support hot air drying can have a plastic-specific course download.). So, since it's a model that doesn't support hot air drying, I asked again if they could just make a low-temperature wash that won't deform the plastic, and they replied that it's not a hot air drying model or something. (Since they don't plan on adding anything. They're probably telling me to buy an expensive model with a plastic-specific course. This is LG's reality, which is completely opposite to ESG.) Sentence (English): Except for some air conditioner models, LGE.com products are expensive.
Comments (English): I got a coupon from Market Kurly. I bought an LG genuine product for 620,000 won. The dishwasher itself is very convenient and good. When considering the purchase model, I chose the one with the pause function and the Up appliance function. However, I didn't use the pause function as much as I thought. (According to the service center, even models without the pause function can pause by slightly opening it by about 2 cm). In the case of the Up appliance function, I was told that I could download it before purchasing. The plastic-only washing function (low-temperature washing) was not there when I actually received it. Since there was an Up appliance idea suggestion in the app, I spent a lot of time and effort on it, but the response was slower than I expected. I only got rejection replies with inconsistent logic. They didn't review it sincerely, so don't waste time like me. Example) I wanted to wash and clean a plastic container, so I asked them to add a low-temperature washing course to the Up appliance. They said that it was not possible because the model did not have a hot air drying function, which has nothing to do with low-temperature washing. I got a weird answer. (I know that models that support hot air drying can have a plastic-specific course download.). So, since it's a model that doesn't support hot air drying, I asked again if they could just make a low-temperature wash that won't deform the plastic, and they replied that it's not a hot air drying model or something. (Since they don't plan on adding anything. They're probably telling me to buy an expensive model with a plastic-specific course. This is LG's reality, which is completely opposite to ESG.) Sentence (English): I can't believe I bought this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Worst washer ever - tiny capacity, must pre-clean ] || ---------------- || I can't believe I bought this dishwasher. The layout of the bottom drawer is terrible. Cooking a meal with a few different dishes? After the meal is over, you can decide which you want to wash first: plates and other serving items (maybe enough serving items), or pots and pans. Serving bowls in one of the loads? Pray. Plan on having to run at least two loads. The bottom rack also has a gigantic cutlery basket sufficient for dinner for 12 (and it would take running it 7-8 times to wash all the dishes), which takes up a huge amount of space. Oh, and don't forget to scrub everything really well, because the dishwasher is incapable of removing anything except very wet spots. Have any baking sheets taller than 11" (like a standard 11x17 pan). Congratulations - it won't fit, even with the middle shelf placed as high as possible - it would get hit by the washing arm. I guess I feel good that I'm saving water by not washing by hand, but that's the only positive. Horrible.

Very disappointed and may end up switching my brand allegiance over this.

Sentence (English): I've had the dishwasher for over a month now.
Comments (English): [ Impressive! ] || ---------------- || I've had the dishwasher for over a month now. I was totally in awe as to how silent it is when in operation. It is a good thing that a red light shows on the floor to indicate that it is running. The dishwasher runs about every other day for a full load. I prefer using the top rack for utensils instead of the basket on the lower rack. When the dishwasher is done, it is easy to sort similar utensils for putting away. The top rack is also great for placing greasy baking racks. The second rack fits all of our coffee mugs and water glasses without problems. It also holds the rubbermaid acrylic containers nicely. I have not lowered the 2nd rack to fit items at this time. We use more bowl type dinnerware than plates, and I am still trying to figure out the most efficient way of placing them in because it appears that I leave too much empty space. I like the auto air cycle where the door pops open when done; it's a good reminder that there are dishes to put away. Thus far, the only a bit of moisture left is on the bottom of the mugs. I tried running the cycle w/o the auto air, and when I opened the door, it seemed that there was more moisture left in the washer; there was a lot of humidity. Overall, I love the dishwasher. It is doing what I expect it to do giving me squeaky clean dishes each and every time.

Sentence (English): The features of this dishwasher are stellar, the performance is good, and the quality and reliability is terrible.
Comments (English): [ Complete failure after five years ] || ---------------- || The features of this dishwasher are stellar, the performance is good, and the quality and reliability is terrible.We bought a suite of LG appliances for our kitchen remodel, including this dishwasher, and installed them in July 2019 (it is now July 2024). We had a technician out about the dishwasher within the first year due to an error code it kept throwing which caused it to stop running. The technician told us we were using too much / the wrong soap and needed to periodically run the machine clean cycle - OK fine. We made those changes and it resolved the error (although I would think a $1,200 dishwasher should be able to handle whatever soap a consumer wants to use, but fine).Then, at least a year ago, possibly longer, some of the lights on the control panel went out. By then, the warranty and extended warranty had ended so I didn't call a technician out. I could still use the dishwasher and didn't want to pay for a service fee and what I assumed would be an expensive part.More recently, we noticed the door gasket was failing, and within the past year, parts of the middle rack started to disintegrate. But, the dishwasher still ran and still cleaned the dishes. until a couple of days ago.I ran the dishwasher overnight like always, and in the morning it was flashing an error code. The dishes seemed clean so I thought maybe I just needed to run the machine clean cycle. I couldn't really tell what the error code was since the control panel lights don't work so well. When I tried to run the cycle, the dishwasher wouldn't start. Long story short, I scheduled a technician to come out who told me that there are multiple problems with the machine (electrical / wiring issues - the thing was literally smoking from him testing whether it would start), the motor is likely also bad based on the error code, the control panel will only get worse and eventually we won't be able to start the machine even if we fix the other issues, and the rack would need to be replaced. Basically, to fix this dishwasher properly will cost as much or more than buying a new one, with no guarantee the replacement parts won't also wear out in a few years again.In summary:- Control panel lights started going out four years max after purchase.- Middle rack started falling apart in two places about four and a half months after purchase.- Wiring and motor have failed five years after purchase.

Sentence (English): A little background, this dishwasher was purchased as part of a suite (dishwasher, microwave, refrigerator and range) and was professionally installed on 6/10/24.
Comments (English): [ Wow (note sarcasm dripping from letters) ] || ---------------- || A little background, this dishwasher was purchased as part of a suite (dishwasher, microwave, refrigerator and range) and was professionally installed on 6/10/24. I researched dishwashers A LOT and was excited to find one that was 39 dBA and beautiful to boot. The dishwasher was one of the determining factors on buying this suite (the other was the microwave - which I love, by the way). I was very excited to have a dishwasher as after a house fire (caused by a contractor) and renovation, I was tasked to wash every dish, pot, pan and piece of silverware I owned (and I'm old - so there is a lot). The first time I went to use the dishwasher, it ran for 30 or so minutes and then stopped, flashing an error code (8-4). I called KitchenAid and a service call was initiated. The technician came out and said that he had never seen a leak like that (it leaks from a gray canister-looking thing into the drip tray and raises the float to cause the machine to stop and error). That was a week and a half ago - not a peep from anyone. I have washed all my dishes, pots, pans, etc - and dried them BY HAND (in addition to working my full time and part-time job). At this point, the dishwasher is a $1000 paperweight that I purchased to make life a little easier. It made it harder. I did give it 1 star, because it was very quiet - FOR THE 30 MINUTES THAT IT RAN. I have always loved KitchenAid, but today, my beautiful black Artisan mixer is hanging its head in shame on the counter.

Sentence (English): Our previous dishwasher died after less than six years of use, and the repair technician we had out to take a look at it recommended we upgrade to a Bosch.
Comments (English): Our previous dishwasher died after less than six years of use, and the repair technician we had out to take a look at it recommended we upgrade to a Bosch. We love it so far- it cleans and dries dishes significantly better than our last dishwasher did, and is very quiet. It was also really easy to install. Home Depot, however, really disappointed us with this transaction. The dishwasher was delivered with a defective exhaust drain, which we didn't discover until the unit was installed and we ran a test cycle. It dumped water all over the inside of a cabinet. We reported it as defective within 24 hours of delivery and we were given an appointment a week later (after already waiting a week for delivery) to have someone come out and take a look. After waiting a week for this appointment, we never got a service window notification, so we called and were told our appointment was cancelled because the service provider we were assigned to doesn't do installs (we didn't need installation, just a replacement defective part). If we had not called, we would have never known, because we were not informed about the cancellation. Home Depot ended up having someone from Bosch call us and they helpfully overnighted the correct part. We replaced it ourselves and the dishwasher works great now.

Sentence (English): This is our third purchase of a Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Not as good as previously purchased Bosch ] || ---------------- || This is our third purchase of a Bosch dishwasher. The first was in 2018 and the dishwasher was fantastic! Because of that we purchased our next one for our new home. It was the 300 series and the quality was substandard compared to the first one. We returned the 300 series to Best Buy because it was so noisy and did not clean the dishes properly. We upgraded to the 500 series for an extra $350. Although better than the 300 series it still does not even come close to the first one we purchased in 2018. It is quiet but probably because it came with an insulation blanket which the 300 did not have. Certainly not worth the extra $350. The interior racks are flimsy and it comes with only one small cutlery holder and we were told we could purchase an extra one at our cost, of course. The cutlery comes out stained which never happened with the original one and we had water from our well then. We are very disappointed in this Bosch dishwasher, but will keep it only because it may be better than other products out there. Unfortunately, it is now the way of our World, to have products cheapened by the manufacturers and get charged more money for inferior products.

Sentence (English): They say "threes the charm" and this is our third Bosch dishwasher in 20 years.
Comments (English): [ Threes the Charm ] || ---------------- || They say "threes the charm" and this is our third Bosch dishwasher in 20 years. We were happy with the first one but they keep getting fancier and more complicated. Personally, I prefer the simple one. We were a bit intimidated at first and it felt like you had to be a computer programmer to run the thing, but I found the one and only setting I ever need and now I am comfortable with it. So far the best thing about this model is the way the middle shelf can be shifted so taller items can fit below. That is useful and cool. I can do without the upper shelf. The basket for silverware works fine and takes no time to load and unload. Putting flatware one at a time into those special grooves in the top area is just too fussy for me. I still casually throw the flatware into the basket and just grab a handful of them at the end. less time consuming I think. Although I know other people like the new shelf way. We noticed that everything didn't get clean up there. The overall look is beautiful and I especially love how quiet this dishwasher is. That is actually the number one best thing about it! I convinced my daughter to buy one because it helps reduce the noise level in her small apartment when her two small boys are being small boys.

If I could make changes: I would make it so the front bottom panel is easier to remove in case there is any leaks, and that there would be more room underneath for a water sensor (paranoid about slow leaks after our previous dishwasher). Also the water line connects to the very back which would make leaks even harder to detect if they occur there.

Comments (English): [ A Developing Friendship ] || ---------------- || But not great. My old dishwasher was like an old friend. I'll probably remove them eventually because my glasses dont fit with them in place. Regarding the app and phone connection? Bosch and I communicate frequently! I can also customize different wash cycles through the app. This is a great option to have for really dirty casseroles to delicate, fine china. Bosch is SO quiet as I fall asleep - I dont hear a peep. Overnight, Bosch will have sent me a text with updates and also when the cycle is complete. Bosch IS an excellent dishwasher and sanitizer (I love that sanitizer option). Bosch's surface appearance is quite lovely: simple, shiny, and so easy to keep clean!

I can usually fit one really large item without it interfering. I'll accept that since I can fit much more into this.

Another terrific feature is the ability to wash only one rack of dishes versus the full capacity of the dishwasher. I generally run the dishwasher in the evening before we go to bed. We are very pleased with the dishwasher and the performance.

Sentence (English): There are pros and cons with this model, but overall we are very satisfied with our purchase and recommend this model.
Comments (English): [ Perfect 10 on Performance! ] || ---------------- || There are pros and cons with this model, but overall we are very satisfied with our purchase and recommend this model. Our previous dishwasher had the silverware basket on the door. I do miss that and feel as though having the silverware basket on the lower rack takes up extra room where I could have more plates and dishes. There are essentially three levels/racks to load dishes. The top rack has very little clearance from the top of the dishwasher. I had initially thought that this shelf would be great for my larger serving utensils. After running a cycle with them up there, I was disappointed to find that they did not get cleaned very well from the bottom up due to it being blocked by the items below on the 2nd rack. Items on the 3rd removable shelf mainly cleaned from the top down. I am in the habit of maximizing the space in my dishwasher when loading and have struggled with the tines collapsing very easily when I am loading dishes. Some might find that convenient for fitting rather large items in. I do not run extremely large items in my dishwasher so I found it to be a bit of an annoyance. There are many positives about this dishwasher that outweigh the minor annoyances. I appreciate the flexibility to remove, raise, and lower racks with ease. This allows many configurations when loading the dishwasher and accommodates various sizes of items. Each rack has glide rails that allow the rack to be rolled in and out with great ease, even when loaded with heavier items. Another terrific feature is the ability to wash only one rack of dishes versus the full capacity of the dishwasher. I generally run the dishwasher in the evening before we go to bed. I love the night dry feature that continues to vent them throughout the evening so I wake up to dry dishes without water on them. This dishwasher is extremely quiet. Initially I would check regularly to be sure that it was still running and that no one had interrupted the cycle. We've installed the app and appreciate that it alerts us when our rinse aid is running low and tells me when the dishwasher is done. Again, it's so quiet when it runs that I can't tell when the cycle is complete just by listening. The dishwasher also has an LED display to indicate the time remaining in the cycle and display 'end' when it has finished the cycle. I absolutely love this sleek outer appearance of the dishwasher with the hidden control panel. It matched perfectly with my other brand appliances. The fingerprint resistant finish easily wipes clean. Most importantly, the dishwasher does a fantastic job. Perfect 10 on performance. We scrape food off of our plates and containers and load them into the dishwasher. We generally use the one hour cycle, and it does a superb job, leaving all of our dishes clean and spot free! We are very pleased with the dishwasher and the performance.

Sentence (English): We recently purchased a Bosch 300 Series Dishwasher, model SHE53C86N, to replace our 11-year-old Kenmore.
Comments (English): [ Nifty Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We recently purchased a Bosch 300 Series Dishwasher, model SHE53C86N, to replace our 11-year-old Kenmore. This new unit cost more and has fewer features, but enough to get the job done. I'm still getting used to filling the racks, which are laid out in an unusual way. There seems to be plenty of room, and there are features that allow the racks to be modified to suit a variety of dishes, pots and pans. The door and rack tracks feel a bit flimsy when operated, and I wonder whether I am seeing some "planned obselescence". I hear that dishwashers are now only lasting 4 to 7 years, but I also heard that Bosch does well in the longevity department. Time will tell. Another reason we went for the Bosch is the top-rack silverware drawer. Like other Bosch owners we talked to, we really like this feature. Our Kenmore had a light that indicated the wash cycle was done, and that light stayed on until the door was opened and closed again, helping insure that we didn't accidentally load dirty dishes in with clean. The Bosch notifies the app when it is done (which I like) but the lights on the machine go out after a short time, making it easier to load dirty in with clean by mistake. Dishes seem to come clean in a normal cycle, and drying is adequate. We are happy with the machine's performance so far.

Sentence (English): We finally had to replace our old dishwasher and wanted a super nice and super quiet unit.
Comments (English): [ Love this dishwasher! ] || ---------------- || We finally had to replace our old dishwasher and wanted a super nice and super quiet unit. We give the Benchmark 5 stars; you will not be disappointed. It does amazing at getting everything spotless. We do use JetDry and we have hard water so we use dishwasher salt; there is a place for it. The third rack is great. The adjusting second self is a huge benefit to accommodate large and odd size cookware. But let me tell you this: bend back the bottom rack's handle just a bit. If not, it will scratch the stainless steal door. It may already come this way but not to worry. I took some advice and bent back the handle just a smidge so no metal on metal contact and our scatch was caught in time, right after the fist load; a nice scrubbing of baking soda using only my finger polised it right out. The scratch can still be seen but it is very superficial and the stainless steel finish was saved. That's my only gripe (others have posted about this as well online). Hopefully Bosch corrects this slight error. Highly recommend this unit!

Sentence (English): This is our second 500 series Bosch dishwasher -- purchased after we moved to a new home with seriously outdated appliances.
Comments (English): [ Great performance, but poor design changes ] || ---------------- || This is our second 500 series Bosch dishwasher -- purchased after we moved to a new home with seriously outdated appliances. The new machine performs as admirably as the original. It's almost silent in our kitchen, and the auto air function means our dishes get very dry. We love that there's no exposed heating element to melt our plasticware, and the three rack design is a must-have for us now. Bosch seems to have made some questionable design changes since our earlier model (purchased from the same big box retailer approximately 2 years prior). For example, now the machine comes with a single flatware basket instead of two. Maybe that works for some, but not us. We often use the top rack for larger utensils so we can't count on that as a extra flatware rack. Also, the flip-down shelves on the middle rack to hold wine glass stems or small cups have shrunk by probably 50%. They used to extend the full length of the rack. Now they barely cover half. All in all, still a stellar machine but would easily be 5 stars without these changes that make it slightly less amazing.

Sentence (English): We had a Bosch for 20 years, it worked perfectly.
Comments (English): We had a Bosch for 20 years, it worked perfectly. We replaced it with this Bosch in February. I like the layout of the racks. Tonight even that would not work. I will be calling the company, but I have no expectations of them fixing it. The easiest and simplest thing for me is probably to buy a different company's dishwasher. Do Not buy Bosch unless or until they build a more robust panel which you know, actually Starts the machine.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher does a great job cleaning dishes and is very quiet.
Comments (English): [ Quiet Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher does a great job cleaning dishes and is very quiet. My model with the handle for hanging a hand towel has the control panel with time display on the top of the door. There are led lights on the front panel to indicate when the washer is running and when the cleaning cycle is complete. There are different cleaning modes that you can select: auto sensing; normal; heavy; delicate, and quick wash. With the wifi app you can also add more wash cycles if you want to get fancy. For lightly soiled dishes we use a quick wash and the dishwasher runs for one hour. Other cycles have different wash times and wash temperatures. You can select a normal wash when the washer is packed with dishes, or a heavy wash for things like pots and pans if they need a tough cleaning. We mostly use the auto sensing mode and dishes have been clean and spot free.If you can wait to take your dishes out the next morning, select a wash without dry boost and the dishes will dry overnight with the help of a fan. If you want your dishes sooner, add dry boost to your wash cycle and your dishes will be heated to dry. The dry boost will add varied times to the wash depending on the clean mode you choose. The washer also lets you place dirtier dishes on the lower rack and choose a setting that provides stronger cleaning to the bottom rack. Overall the dishwasher is simple to operate, easy to load and unload, and has done a much better job at cleaning dishes than our old machine.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher does a great job cleaning dishes and is very quiet.
Comments (English): [ Quiet Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher does a great job cleaning dishes and is very quiet. My model with the handle for hanging a hand towel has the control panel with time display on the top of the door. There are led lights on the front panel to indicate when the washer is running and when the cleaning cycle is complete. There are different cleaning modes that you can select: auto sensing; normal; heavy; delicate, and quick wash. With the wifi app you can also add more wash cycles if you want to get fancy. For lightly soiled dishes we use a quick wash and the dishwasher runs for one hour. Other cycles have different wash times and wash temperatures. You can select a normal wash when the washer is packed with dishes, or a heavy wash for things like pots and pans if they need a tough cleaning. We mostly use the auto sensing mode and dishes have been clean and spot free. If you can wait to take your dishes out the next morning, select a wash without dry boost and the dishes will dry overnight with the help of a fan. If you want your dishes sooner, add dry boost to your wash cycle and your dishes will be heated to dry. The dry boost will add varied times to the wash depending on the clean mode you choose. The washer also lets you place dirtier dishes on the lower rack and choose a setting that provides stronger cleaning to the bottom rack. Overall the dishwasher is simple to operate, easy to load and unload, and has done a much better job at cleaning dishes than our old machine.

Sentence (English): Welcome to those who want to escape from dishwashing hell.
Comments (English): [ It's a good price. ] || ---------------- || Welcome to those who want to escape from dishwashing hell. I am a 50-year-old housewife who loves cooking and has a family of four and dishes pile up every time I turn around. All housewives are curious about dishwashers. However, they are expensive, and since they are washed with hot water, the electricity bill will be expensive, and it seems like they will use a lot of water. And will it be cleaner than washing them by hand? You may be wondering about this and that. I am also a suspicious person. I have searched a lot on YouTube and other sites. Whether it is a brand or not, it is all the same. There are differences depending on the dishwasher, but these days, if you use a dishwasher once a day, it costs about 2,750 won per month. Of course, there is a progressive tax rate, so it will be a little different for each household and machine. You only need about 16% of the water compared to washing dishes by hand? Wow~ I was surprised by this part. If you put them in the dishwasher after dinner, you will escape from the dishwashing hell where your apron gets soaked every day. After about an hour, the dishwasher door automatically opens and the hot air dries the washed dishes quickly with the strong residual heat of 75 degrees. The next morning, you can just put away the dried dishes. The sink is clean and the apron is fluffy. A new life begins. I wonder why I put off and worried about such convenience. In fact, I don't even wear rubber gloves. When I wash dishes, I can't feel the oil or the slipperiness. I have to feel the squeak with my hands. However, the dishwasher sprays strongly and sterilizes with hot water, so I feel reassured. As for whether it washes cleanly. Well. In fact, all dishwashers need to soak dried food before putting it in. It's overkill to even wash the larvae. If that's the case, I'll just wash the dishes. You have to soak the dishes from breakfast and lunch in water so that they're washed well when you turn it on once in the evening. However, dried dishes really don't wash well regardless of the company's product. Even if the dishes are arranged slightly wrong, there are parts that are less washed. This product is a product of a company called Media. The price is for 12 people, but it is half the price of large brand brands. In fact, this is a huge merit. Of course, it is not a large company. Since there are many shortcomings such as AS center, the price is a very surprising part. However, I think that all products produced these days are similar. Automatic door opening. Bowl selection. Strong/weak selection, eco mode, quick mode, larval rinse, etc. All the parts needed for a dishwasher these days are in this dishwasher. As for the design, it is a matter of personal taste, so there are good and bad reviews. I thought the matte and simple design was not bad. The user manual is really easy to understand as much as the simple design. If you want to add dishes while using it, you can open the door and put them in. If you run it in the kitchen, you will not hear any noise in the living room. The video was taken right in front of you, so please refer to the noise. There is no noise that you feel is noisy at all. I put all the dishes in the dishwasher and ran it again this evening. After about an hour, the washing was finished, and most of the dishes were cleaned well. The dishes that were oily were clean. When using dishes right after the automatic door opens after washing, you have to dry them. There is a lot of moisture left. If you open it in the morning like me, it is almost dry. Sentence (English): The size is just right for a family of 3~4 people.

Overall, I'm satisfied and using it.
Comments (Original): 3~4인 가정 사이즈 딱 좋아요. 1~2인 가정은 더 작은사이즈가 좋을 것 같아요. 기능은 표준, 상하 구분 등 주로 사용하는 것만 쓰게되어서 많을 필요가 없네요. 코스별 온도 안내가 있었으면 좋겠어요. 급속코스가 온도가 조금 낮다고 봐서, 플라스틱이나 약한소재는 급속코스에 건조없이 사용하고있어요. 프로쉬 고체 세제 반잘라서 사용중인데, 완료후 하얀자국 남아요. 식기세척기 설치전 물 경도체크 해주실때, 소금사용 안해도 괜찮다고 하셔서 그냥 사용중이예요. 점점 심해지면 전용 소금 연수장치 사용하려고요. 사용해본 결과 장단점은 2인이상 가정엔 필수 가전이고, 깊은 컵이나 냄비는 손으로 하는게 낫거나 애벌 필요하더라 정도예요. 전체적으로 만족하며 사용중입니다.
